label: TP
reason: SQL injection alert is TRUE POSITIVE: user input from request.getParameter() flows through doSomething() via ternary operator (condition 188>200 is false, so param=bar) into the SQL string without sanitization. The SQL query is built with string concatenation and passed to queryForObject(), enabling injection attacks. XSS alert is secondary (encodingForHTML mitigates reflection to browser, but SQL injection remains exploitable).

evidence.note: User input flows from getParameter() -> param -> doSomething() -> bar -> sql without sanitization
